items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: My wife, Daniella, I met her in Switzerland

ctx.x: The gumbo, exactly. You just take it and mix it all up and make something new, and that’s how we get where we are. But it’s very interesting. And I just say to everybody, come to New Orleans. Come to New Orleans and experience it. My wife, Daniella, I met her in Switzerland, and it’s like — you know I often think about that, God, I love her, you know, cause man I don’t know how much longer she can stay. Hopefully she’ll stay. She’s been dropped out from the Swiss Alps.
